page.overview:
Who is Gurney?

Admiral Gurney was a late 24th century Starfleet flag officer.

In 2399, this admiral was assigned to Starfleet Headquarters.

When retired Admiral Jean-Luc Picard visited Starfleet Headquarters to speak with Fleet admiral Kirsten Clancy, Admiral Gurney was paged to report to conference room A. ()
